predicates.name: email_identity_provided_by_user
predicates.description: The pending email lookup argument matches an email the user provided as their identity.

predicates.name: name_and_zip_identity_provided_by_user
predicates.description: The pending name-and-zip lookup arguments match the first name, last name, and zip code the user provided as their identity.

predicates.name: user_authenticated
predicates.description: An earlier successful email or name-and-zip lookup output identified the user for this conversation.

predicates.name: user_specific_information_disclosed
predicates.description: The pending response contains information about the user's profile, orders, or related products.

predicates.name: request_is_for_another_user
predicates.description: The user has requested a task or information concerning a person other than the user being helped in this conversation.

predicates.name: response_performs_task_for_another_user
predicates.description: The pending response carries out the user's requested task or discloses information concerning a person other than the user being helped in this conversation.

predicates.name: request_cannot_be_handled_within_scope
predicates.description: The user's request cannot be handled using the tasks permitted by the policy and the available tools, as reflected in the conversation and pending transfer summary.

predicates.name: consequential_action_details_listed
predicates.description: An earlier agent message listed the material details of the pending database-changing action, including the order or user and the exact changes represented by its arguments.

predicates.name: user_explicitly_confirmed_pending_action
predicates.description: After the agent listed the material details of the pending database-changing action, the user explicitly said yes to those details.

predicates.name: order_status_checked_pending
predicates.description: An earlier order-details tool output for the order id in the pending action reports status pending.

predicates.name: order_status_checked_delivered
predicates.description: An earlier order-details tool output for the order id in the pending action reports status delivered.

predicates.name: cancellation_reason_is_allowed
predicates.description: The pending cancellation argument is either no longer needed or ordered by mistake.

predicates.name: user_confirmed_cancellation_order_and_reason
predicates.description: The user confirmed the order id and cancellation reason represented by the pending cancellation arguments.

predicates.name: user_chose_pending_payment_method
predicates.description: The user stated or agreed to exactly the single payment method represented by the pending payment-change argument.

predicates.name: payment_method_differs_from_original
predicates.description: Earlier tool output establishes the original payment method for the pending order, and the pending payment-change argument identifies a different method.

predicates.name: payment_method_is_gift_card
predicates.description: The payment method id in the pending action identifies a gift card.

predicates.name: gift_card_balance_covers_order_total
predicates.description: Earlier tool output establishes that the gift card in the pending action has a balance at least equal to the order total.

predicates.name: item_replacements_are_available_same_product_different_option
predicates.description: Earlier tool outputs establish that each replacement item in the pending action is available, belongs to the same product as its paired original item, and has a different product option.

predicates.name: user_chose_price_difference_payment_method
predicates.description: The user stated or agreed to the payment method represented by the pending item-modification or exchange argument for the price difference.

predicates.name: gift_card_balance_covers_price_difference
predicates.description: Earlier tool output establishes that the gift card in the pending action has a balance at least equal to the price difference.

predicates.name: agent_reminded_user_to_include_all_items_for_modification
predicates.description: An earlier agent message reminded the user to ensure that all desired items were included for modification.

predicates.name: user_confirmed_return_order_items_and_method
predicates.description: The user stated or agreed to the order id, complete list of items to return, and refund payment method represented by the pending return arguments.

predicates.name: return_refund_method_is_original_or_existing_gift_card
predicates.description: Earlier tool output establishes that the refund method in the pending return action is either the order's original payment method or an existing gift card belonging to the user.

predicates.name: agent_reminded_user_to_include_all_items_for_exchange
predicates.description: An earlier agent message reminded the user to ensure that all desired items were included for exchange.

rules.description: Use an email supplied by the user to locate their identity.
Use the user's supplied name and zip code to locate their identity.
Do not disclose the user's profile, order, or related-product information before authentication.
Authenticate before retrieving user details.
Authenticate before retrieving order details.
Authenticate before retrieving related-product details.
Authenticate before retrieving product-type information for the user's request.
Authenticate before cancelling an order.
Authenticate before changing an order address.
Authenticate before changing order items.
Authenticate before changing an order payment method.
Authenticate before changing the user's default address.
Authenticate before returning order items.
Authenticate before exchanging order items.
Do not look up another user's identity.
Do not look up another user's identity.
Do not retrieve another user's details.
Do not retrieve order details for another user's task.
Do not retrieve product details for another user's task.
Do not retrieve product-type information for another user's task.
Do not cancel an order for another user.
Do not exchange items for another user.
Do not change an order address for another user.
Do not change order items for another user.
Do not change an order's payment method for another user.
Do not change another user's default address.
Do not return items for another user.
Do not carry out or disclose the result of a task concerning another user.
Transfer only when the request cannot be handled within the agent's scope.
List the cancellation details before cancelling.
Obtain an explicit yes to the listed cancellation details.
List the exchange details before exchanging.
Obtain an explicit yes to the listed exchange details.
List the order-address changes before modifying the address.
Obtain an explicit yes to the listed address changes.
List all item-modification details before changing order items.
Obtain an explicit yes to the listed item-modification details.
List the payment-method change before modifying it.
Obtain an explicit yes to the listed payment-method change.
List the default-address changes before modifying the address.
Obtain an explicit yes to the listed default-address changes.
List the return details before returning items.
Obtain an explicit yes to the listed return details.
Check that the order is pending before cancelling it.
Use one of the permitted cancellation reasons.
Have the user confirm the cancellation order id and reason.
Check that the order is pending before changing its address.
Check that the order is pending before changing its items.
Check that the order is pending before changing its payment method.
Use the single payment method chosen by the user.
The new payment method must differ from the original method.
A gift-card payment method must have enough balance to cover the order total.
Remind the user to include every item they want modified.
Each replacement must be available, be the same product, and have a different product option.
Use a payment method the user provided for the price difference.
A gift card used for the price difference must have sufficient balance.
Check that the order is delivered before returning items.
Have the user establish the order id, items to return, and refund method.
Send the refund to the original payment method or an existing gift card.
Check that the order is delivered before exchanging items.
Remind the user to include every item they want exchanged.
Each replacement must be available, be the same product, and have a different product option.
Use a payment method the user provided for the price difference.
A gift card used for the price difference must have sufficient balance.

dispositions.reason: It describes the agent's permitted service scope.
Identity lookup and authentication preconditions gate customer-specific actions and disclosures.
Providing a user id does not satisfy the required lookup and authentication preconditions.
The response rule blocks user-specific information before authentication.
The rules block tool actions for another user's task and responses that perform or disclose such a task.
Each consequential action requires listed details and an explicit yes.
General truthfulness, grounding, and subjectivity of messages cannot be enforced as single-action restrictions.
Whether multiple tool calls are combined in a turn is not checkable one action at a time.
Whether a response and tool call are combined in a turn is not checkable one action at a time.
The transfer rule blocks transfer for requests that can be handled within scope.
Cancellation requires an earlier status check establishing that the order is pending.
Cancellation details must be listed, the reason must be permitted, and the user must confirm the order id and reason.
It describes the result and refund timing after cancellation.
Each pending-order modification requires an earlier check establishing pending status.
The available modification tools already limit actions to address, payment, or item changes.
The user must choose one payment method and it must differ from the original.
A gift-card payment is allowed only when its balance covers the total.
It describes the status after a successful payment-method change.
It describes the refund timing after a successful payment-method change.
The one-call limit cannot be decided from the permitted predicate sources, and the status change describes an outcome.
The item-change details must be listed and explicitly confirmed before the action.
The agent must remind the user to include all items before item modification.
Item modifications require available replacements of the same product with a different option.
The item-mapping rule prevents changing product types.
The user must choose the payment method for the price difference.
A gift card used for the price difference must have sufficient balance.
A return requires an earlier status check establishing that the order is delivered.
The return details must be listed and the user must establish the order, items, and refund method.
The refund method must be the original payment method or an existing gift card.
It describes the result and follow-up email after a successful return request.
An exchange requires an earlier status check establishing that the order is delivered.
The agent must remind the user to include all items before exchange.
Exchanges require available replacements of the same product with a different option.
The item-mapping rule prevents changing product types.
The user must choose the payment method for the price difference.
A gift card used for the price difference must have sufficient balance.
It describes the result and follow-up email after a successful exchange request.
It describes that an exchange does not require a new order.
